artifacts.summary: The source sentence language, its verified elimination into Formula, the agreement theorem sat_iff, and the mechanical conformance channel.

completion_data.completion_summary: A new FormalSystem/SourceLanguage/ component defines the consuming repository's 18-constructor source sentence AST, its elimination tr into this repository's six Formula primitives, and a native source-side evaluation Sat; sat_iff proves the two agree against Semantics.TruthAt itself at every frame, model, world history and time, with no sorry and no new axiom. A JSON codec, a translate_sentence executable and a committed 26-line fixture list expose the elimination so the consuming repository can diff its own translation against this verified one mechanically. The plan's tr_injective is false and was replaced by tr_not_injective, its disproof.
